'''Digger''' was an [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] and one of a group of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] left behind on [[Pengalan IV]] after their [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] was shot down during a full scale [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Battle of Pengalan IV|retreat]].<ref name="The Pengalan Tradeoff" />

Abandoned with his fellow troopers and a Republic accountant named [[Joram Kithe]], they were on their own to figure out how to get off the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. When Kithe awoke and revealed that he had been commissioned as a [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], Digger was the first trooper to speak to him.<ref name="The Pengalan Tradeoff" />

Kithe was disturbed by the troopers' reliance on proper procedure, and tried to foster individuality in them. To that end, he gave the troopers nicknames. Digger gained his nickname because he was digging graves for the gunship's dead the first time Kithe spoke to him.<ref name="The Pengalan Tradeoff" />

After making their way to [[Tur Lorkin]], the nearest village, and infiltrating a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] bay, [[Tooth (clone)|Tooth]] and Kithe realized that the village was in fact the site of the [[diamond boron missile]] manufacturing facility, not the factory which had been the site of the earlier trap.<ref name="The Pengalan Tradeoff" />

Determined to destroy it, Tooth faced Kithe and was willing to defy the man's orders to complete his mission. Impressed, Kithe relented. The troopers sabotaged the factory with Kithe's aid while Tooth stole a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] ship to draw the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] away from the starship bay, allowing Joram and the remaining troopers to escape. Digger was in [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]] contact with him, and heard Tooth go down. Digger took a leading role in the assault on the factory, shielding captured missiles with his body and frequently taking point and making decisions with Kithe.<ref name="The Pengalan Tradeoff" />

He survived the mission, and would continue to serve with the other survivors.<ref name="League of Spies">{{InsiderCite|73|The League of Spies}}</ref>
